subject: general
question: Who started a special program called 'Young Scientist Program (YUVIKA - 2019)' for school children?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ISRO**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)** initiated the special program called 'Young Scientist Program (YUVIKA - 2019)' for school children.
 
• The program aims to impart basic knowledge on space technology, space science, and space applications to younger students, especially those from rural areas.
 
• **YUVIKA** stands for 'YUva VIgyani KAryakram', which translates to 'Young Scientist Program'.
 
• The initiative is part of ISRO's outreach program to create awareness about its space activities and to inspire students to pursue a career in science and technology.
 
• Selected students get the opportunity to visit ISRO facilities and interact with top scientists.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO** was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
 
• ISRO's vision is to "harness space technology for national development while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration".
 
• The organization is known for its cost-effective space missions, including the **Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan)** and the **Chandrayaan** missions to the Moon.
 
• ISRO has significantly contributed to India's telecommunications, meteorology, and satellite-based navigation systems.
